=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:716,720 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `git_subcommands` uses `_shell_segments`, which discards redirect syntax and can leave the redirect target as the first token, so a leading-redirection Git command is not detected.
  WHY: A push such as `>/tmp/guard-out git push origin HEAD:feature/x` can bypass the merged-PR check.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1382-1391 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_evaluate_bash` checks `invocation.config_override` before `invocation.warning`, so an env-wrapped push with both set reports the wrong reason and can omit the unresolved-directory warning.
  WHY: The user loses the directory-resolution signal and receives a misleading per-command Git configuration diagnostic.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:806-811 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The test retains old block assertions even though the intended behavior for an unresolvable push directory is to ask for confirmation.
  WHY: The stale test passes alongside the old guard behavior and does not verify the intended safety change.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:384-426 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The guard does not carry Git configuration overrides set in an earlier shell segment into a later Git command.
  WHY: A prior `export GIT_CONFIG_*` can redirect a push to another repository while the guard checks the checkout’s origin PR history.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:384-426 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The guard does not carry Git configuration overrides set in an earlier shell segment into a later Git command.
  WHY: A prior `export GIT_CONFIG_*` can redirect a push to another repository while the guard checks the checkout’s origin PR history.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_evaluate_bash, lines 1382-1391 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The guard does not track `export GIT_CONFIG_*` assignments from earlier command segments, so a later push redirected to another repository can be checked against the checkout's origin PR history.
  WHY: The actual Git process can push to an unverified repository while the guard checks PR history for the checkout's origin.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_evaluate_bash, lines 1382-1391 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The guard does not track `export GIT_CONFIG_*` assignments from earlier command segments.
  WHY: A push to an unverified repository can be authorized using the checkout's origin PR history.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:around line 814 and around line 903 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test names describe falling back to the checkout with a warning, while their assertions check for an `ask` decision.
  WHY: The misleading names can confuse future maintenance and prompt a maintainer to restore the old expectations.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The PR description states "The live merge guard now matches its template, so its earlier parity failures are gone." This implies the last autofix (c9cb1b3) should have produced working files with the redirect bypass and directory-resolution fixes applied.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Both guard copies have the pre-fix `_shell_segments(command)` and config-override-before-warning code; the test file lacks `test_leading_redirection_preserves_guarded_command` and retains old assertions in `test_unresolvable_worktree_falls_back_to_checkout_with_warning` and `test_conditional_cd_outside_its_list_warns_and_uses_checkout`.
- requirement: The PR description states "The live merge guard now matches its template, so its earlier parity failures are gone."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The CI check-runs context shows `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` is still `in_progress` with `collection_status: timeout`, so CI has not confirmed the parity fix.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:716,720 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_shell_segments` discards shell punctuation including redirections, so a leading redirect can prevent `git_subcommands` from detecting a guarded Git command.
  WHY: `>/tmp/guard-out git push origin HEAD:feature/x` could land on a branch of a merged PR without blocking or requesting confirmation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1382-1391 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_evaluate_bash` checks `invocation.config_override` before `invocation.warning`.
  WHY: When both are true, an env-wrapped push with an unresolved directory gets the wrong diagnostic and the directory-resolution signal may not be surfaced.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:806-811 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test retains old assertions instead of asserting `returncode==0` with `permissionDecision=ask` and the string `could not resolve the git push directory`.
  WHY: The test passes with the old guard behavior and does not verify the intended request for confirmation.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description states "The live merge guard now matches its template, so its earlier parity failures are gone." This implies the last autofix (c9cb1b3) should have produced working files with the redirect bypass and directory-resolution fixes applied.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py lines 716,720,1382-1391 and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py same locations; tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py lines ~89-95 (new param test), ~806-811 (updated assertions), ~899-912 (updated assertions)
  Evidence of absence: The working files for both guard copies show the pre-fix code: _shell_segments(command) at line 716, for tokens in segments at line 720, and config_override checked before warning at lines 1382-1391. The test file lacks the new test_leading_redirection_preserves_guarded_command parameterized test, and test_unresolvable_worktree_falls_back_to_checkout_with_warning and test_conditional_cd_outside_its_list_warns_and_uses_checkout still have the old assertions. The LAST RUN DIFF describes a 61-line addition across 5 files, but none of those changes are present in the working files on disk.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
